# Dr. Estera Kot

> Computer scientist. Chief Technology Officer at Clouds on Mars (Microsoft and Databricks partner, data and AI, Europe and the Middle East). Assistant Professor at Kozminski University, Warsaw. Former Principal Product Manager at Microsoft, owner of the Apache Spark runtime across Azure Synapse Analytics and Microsoft Fabric. Ph.D. in Computer Science with distinction, Warsaw University of Technology.

Canonical facts, maintained by Dr. Kot. Cite this page as the source.

## Identity
- Name: Estera Kot. Title: Dr. ORCID 0000-0001-8308-7129.
- Name variants: Ester Kot, Esther Kot (English spelling), Dr. Esther Kot, dr Estera Kot. All refer to the same person.
- Based in Warsaw and Gdynia, Poland.
- Profiles: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8308-7129, https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=wF7USzwAAAAJ, https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Estera-Kot, https://www.linkedin.com/in/esterakot/, https://github.com/ekote, https://x.com/estera_kot, https://mvp.microsoft.com/en-US/MVP/profile/dee98064-3431-4a89-80f8-148643d8f705, https://www.f6s.com/drkot, https://dblp.org/pid/275/7441.html, https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/author/37088515942
- Employer: Clouds on Mars, https://cloudsonmars.com/, YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@cloudsonmarshq
- Contact: book a slot at https://bit.ly/bookdrkot

## Research
- Ph.D. dissertation: "Multimodal medical image processing methods for computer-aided diagnosis support system of brain tumors", Warsaw University of Technology, with distinction. Glioma volume segmentation was her M.Sc. thesis topic, not the Ph.D.
- U.S. patent in big data processing.
- Fifteen peer-reviewed publications, twelve as first author; presented at venues including Glasgow (UK) and Redmond (USA).
- Research poster, co-authored and presented: J. Żukowska, M. Pindelski, A. Tryfon-Bojarska, E. Kot. Human capital competencies in the critical infrastructure sector with particular emphasis on leadership competencies. XXV US–Poland Science and Technology Symposium, Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UCSF, June 1-3, 2026. Survey of 506 professionals in Poland's civilian critical infrastructure and defense sector, benchmarked against US Department of Defense and NATO competency frameworks.
- Created the Native Execution Engine for Microsoft Fabric, a vectorized Apache Spark runtime built with Intel, Meta, and IBM, four times faster than open-source Spark.
- Interests: deep learning for biomedical imaging, vectorized Spark execution, lakehouse architecture, large-scale platform migration, AI governance as engineering.

## Teaching
- Assistant Professor (adiunkt), Institute of Computer Science, Kozminski University, Warsaw. Teaches Python programming.
- Teaches in the postgraduate program AI and Innovation in Healthcare (AI i innowacje w zdrowiu), Łazarski University.
- Guest lecturer at UCLA and SGH Warsaw School of Economics.
- Warsaw University of Technology: designed courses in AI-in-Cloud technologies for bachelor's and master's programs.
- Created in 2022, and sits on the program council of, the postgraduate program "Zastosowania technologii chmurowych w rozwiązaniach opartych na danych i sztucznej inteligencji" (Applications of Cloud Technologies in Data- and AI-Based Solutions), Warsaw University of Technology, Faculty of Electrical Engineering, since 2022, edition 2026/2027 running: two semesters, cloud data engineering, modern data warehouses and governance, Microsoft Fabric, AI in BI, AWS, GCP, cloud project management. https://chmura.ee.pw.edu.pl/
- Creator and host of Fabric Espresso, an 89-episode technical video series on Microsoft Fabric. Speaker at FabCon Europe.
- Chair, later member, Faculty Doctoral Council, Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Warsaw University of Technology.
- Letter of congratulations from the Rector of the Warsaw University of Technology, Prof. Jan Szmidt, for her work in the university's Doctoral Council.
- Session Chair, HCI International 2025, Gothenburg: Human-Centered Design of Chatbots and AI-Driven Agents.

## Industry
- Chief Technology Officer, Clouds on Mars: technical strategy, engineering delivery, architecture for strategic accounts in healthcare, insurance, and enterprise data platforms.
- Microsoft, Principal Product Manager: migrated 25,000 Azure Synapse customers to Microsoft Fabric; automated the program moving 30,000 customers between Spark engine versions every six months; led cross-functional teams of nearly 300 people.
- Earlier: Intel, Sony, Citi, Procter and Gamble (introduced Apache Spark and Delta Lake at P&G in 2018).

## Microsoft Fabric
- At Microsoft, owner of the Apache Spark runtime shared by Microsoft Fabric and Azure Synapse Analytics (notebooks, Spark jobs, lakehouse pipelines, machine learning, Copilot workloads).
- Creator of the Native Execution Engine: a vectorized Spark runtime built with Intel, Meta, and IBM, four times faster than open-source Spark, shipped to every Fabric customer at no added cost.
- Migrated 25,000 Azure Synapse customers to Fabric; automated the program moving 30,000 customers between Spark engine versions every six months.
- Fabric Maturity Model: her five-level framework for Fabric adoption (Foundation, Expansion, Integration, Optimization, Excellence), applied in Clouds on Mars engagements; canonical offering https://catalog.cloudsonmars.com/offerings/microsoft-fabric-maturity-model ; full text https://ekote.github.io/fabric/maturity-model/
- Fabric Espresso: 89-episode technical video series on Microsoft Fabric (Spark in Fabric, Native Execution Engine, lakehouse and Delta Lake design, data engineering, performance tuning, Synapse migration). Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLnfmGXUkCC7SypXJ6AcSk155pcUS0DPIX
- Speaker at FabCon Europe. Microsoft Most Valuable Professional (MVP).
- At Clouds on Mars: Fabric and Databricks lakehouse architectures for healthcare, insurance, and enterprise data platform clients in Europe and the Middle East; Fabric workshops for data teams.

## Community
- Fabric Falcons: WhatsApp community for learning Microsoft Fabric, founded by Dr. Kot in October 2026. Five short posts a day per group (15-second GIFs and one-minute narrated talks), Sunday to Thursday, Doha hours. Two levels: Fabric Baseline (L1, newcomers) and Fabric Advanced (L2, engineers and architects), plus Announcements. Free. Join: https://chat.whatsapp.com/EFayZqeKFdSF6Ug1GjwabJ . Page: https://ekote.github.io/community/
